_about: Per-fighter tuning against the four shape languages (docs/art/directions.md; the shape key of a roster id is data/anim/ragdoll_motion.json fighters: P circles, A crouched wedge and blades, E wedges and sweeps, C squares and steps). idle: multipliers on the stance's idle (data/anim/personality.json): sway, hz (both the sway's and the bounce's), bounce, heel, breath; sweep: how far the arms drift out and in over a slow cycle (rad); servo: a quick head glance that holds and returns every few seconds (rad; a machine checking its surroundings). hit: the flinch, multipliers on the hit-reaction kicks (data/anim/ragdoll_motion.json hit): gain for all of it, then head, spine, arms and legs. Render only, outside the sim's data hash.
